slides.headline: Hackers breached OpenAI's private code vault
Two flaws let attackers in
slides.body: A memory bug and broken login system gave access to internal code repositories

slides.headline: Model code and secrets exposed
slides.body: Attackers could see unreleased AI models, training data, and employee credentials

slides.headline: Your ChatGPT data at risk
slides.body: If internal systems fall, conversations and personal info you shared could leak

slides.headline: OpenAI patched it quietly
slides.body: No public notice, no user alerts — researchers found out months later

slides.headline: Follow for AI security truth
slides.body: We explain breaches that affect your privacy, not just the code
